about: MSP explanatory codes (MSP list dated 1 Jul 2026, Teleplan bulletin TPBULET-1), the hand-written rows for a telehealth GP practice. msp_wording is MSP's exact text; plain_language, who_fixes and how_to_fix are SimpleCare's plain-English reading (Dev answers, 6 Oct 2026). YY, DR and HK are wrappers: read the next code. Row: code, msp_wording, plain_language, category, outcome, who_fixes, how_to_fix.
